messages:
evan_sales: Hey team — NovaTech wants a 2-day POC next Thursday. Need a hosted API key with tight controls: TTL <= 72h, rotation log export, and an emergency revoke (email + API). Also they may demo from phones. Any recommended pattern?

kari_se: Id issue a scoped short-lived token (48h) with minimal scopes: generate.chat + embeddings.read. For mobile demos, route traffic through your demo backend (token broker). IP allowlist only if theyre on a fixed office network.

kari_se: Create example (use sales service account):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SA_SVC" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"name":"novatech-poc","scopes":["generate.chat","embeddings.read"],"ttl_hours":48}'
```

mike_infra: If customer needs IP allowlist add "ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24"]. We can also enable audit-forwarding to their SIEM for rotation/revoke/create events. Default POC log retention = 90 days.

ada_security: Security checklist: require ticket justification, 2FA on the SA that requests tokens, restrict console token view to an SSO group, and TTL <= 7 days for POCs. If they require regulatory controls, we recommend Private/VPC deployment.

evan_sales: How do we rotate without breaking the demo?

kari_se: Rotation playbook: schedule creation of new key ~2h before expiry -> deploy to demo backend -> smoke-test requests -> switch traffic -> revoke old key. We avoid in-place rotation. For weekend demos we can enable scheduled rotation + webhook/email alerts to the owner.

notify-bot: [automated] key_request_created: id=kr_300321, owner=evan_sales, ttl_hours=48, scope=generate.chat,embeddings.read, status=pending-approval

mike_infra: Approving now. Provisioning will include audit-forwarding toggle. Audit export API (example): GET /v1/audit/events?key_id=kr_300321&from=2134560000&to=2134646399 — returns JSON events (create/rotate/revoke) with ISO timestamps and actor fields. We can sign the export for compliance.

ada_security: Revocation options: API, Console, or verified-email. API revoke example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kr_300321/revoke \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SA_SVC"
```
Verified-email revoke: security@redwood.ai accepts requests including ticket ID + SSO identity; after verification we run the revoke (this creates an audit event and signed export if requested).

evan_sales: Need a short snippet for the onboarding doc that shows create + revoke + audit export.

mike_infra: Ill attach the curl snippets and include a sample signed export (JSON + CSV summary) in the sales ticket. Note on scaling: if the POC transitions to sustained traffic we can spin up a small Dedicated pool and issue a pool-scoped key to separate billing and capacity.

kari_se: Also recommend a single-use rotation token for non-sales operators performing swaps during demos — reduces long-lived credentials exposure.

evan_sales: Awesome. Please cc me on ticket updates and enable webhook alerts 4h before expiry. Leaving this thread open until the signed export is attached. :thumbsup:
